name: search_documents
description: Use when the user wants to find documents by keyword, filter by a date range, or page through large result sets.

query.description: The full-text search query. Words are matched case-insensitively.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 20, capped at 100.

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 date; only documents modified on or after it are returned.
